raw_context: Viral catchphrase from Indian-Filipino Facebook/TikTok vlogger Mr. Nobodydudy (Navhot Singh), October 2023. He pronounced 'mix mix' with an Indian accent in his comedic street food reaction videos. Went viral in the Philippines with 3.4M Facebook followers. Manila Bulletin, NoypiGeeks, PhilNews, Time in Manila, and Wiktionary all document the phenomenon. Active in Filipino memes and social media 2023-2025.

Gen Z Filipino exclamation clipped from 'hala ka!' Used in social media, group chats, and TikTok comments to express shock, disbelief, or alarm. Documented by italki Pinoy Slang series (#10), HiNative, Quora, and ling-app.com. Widespread usage 2024-2025 on Filipino Twitter/X and TikTok.
